segments.contextAfter: `coefficients`: A pointer to an array of polynomial coefficient arrays. Each polynomial coefficient array contains the coefficients for one polynomial. A polynomial of order `R` has `R+1` coefficients, and all of the polynomials in this array must have the same order. Order the coefficients from the zeroth-order term to the highest order term. For example, the function evaluates the coefficients `[0.5, 0.6, 0.7]` as `0.5 * x⁰ + 0.6 * x¹ + 0.7 * x²`.

segments.contextAfter: `boundaries`: A pointer to an array of boundary values, in increasing order, that separates adjacent ranges of pixel values. The first boundary value is the lowest in the range and the function clips input values lower than this to this value. The last boundary value is the highest in the range and the function clips input values higher than this to this value. The boundary values between the first and last separate the subranges from each other.
